BriefInstructions: Step 1: Clean the fish and marinate with salt and turmeric.
Step 2: Heat mustard oil in a pan until it smokes.
Step 3: Fry the fish until golden brown; set aside.
Step 4: Add diced potatoes and fry until lightly browned.
Step 5: Add tomatoes, ginger, and spices; cook until mushy.
Step 6: Add water to make a thin curry base.
Step 7: Return fish to the pan and simmer for 10 minutes.
Step 8: Garnish with fresh coriander and serve hot.
Suggestion: Already healthy. Use less oil for a lighter version.

BriefInstructions: Step 1: Cook rice and allow it to cool.
Step 2: Soak rice in water overnight.
Step 3: Chop green chilies finely.
Step 4: Serve soaked rice with yogurt and green chilies.
Suggestion: Use brown rice for added fiber and nutrients.

BriefInstructions: Step 1: Clean and devein prawns; marinate with turmeric and salt.
Step 2: Heat oil in a pan and fry prawns; set aside.
Step 3: In the same pan, fry onions until golden.
Step 4: Add ginger-garlic paste and cook for 2 minutes.
Step 5: Add turmeric, chili powder, and garam masala.
Step 6: Pour in coconut milk and simmer for 5 minutes.
Step 7: Add prawns and cook for another 5 minutes.
Step 8: Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve with rice.
Suggestion: Use light coconut milk to reduce fat content.

BriefInstructions: Step 1: Prepare dough with wheat flour, water, and salt.
Step 2: Mix sattu with spices and mustard oil to make stuffing.
Step 3: Roll the dough into small balls and stuff with sattu mix.
Step 4: Bake stuffed dough balls until golden brown.
Step 5: Boil potatoes and mash with spices to make chokha.
Step 6: Roast eggplant (optional) for additional chokha flavor.
Step 7: Serve litti with chokha and ghee.
Suggestion: Add more vegetables to chokha or use multigrain flour.
